snippet.title: Mimic Busters - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out! 

Mimic Busters is a co-op Hide-and-Seek game from Tape Corps & DevAdam 

#MimicBusters #Gaming #IGN
